method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

checks.command: l4 run cca-patron.l4 ; l4 run cca-cases-patron.l4 ; l4 run cca-qa.l4 ; l4 run cca-qa-cases.l4 ; l4 check cca-qa.l4
checks.result: 246 assertions satisfied (69 baseline + 177 Q&A layer, 2026-11-06, after the Q9 fix), 0 errors, 0 warnings in all four files; l4 check cca-qa.l4: Check succeeded; parameter script: 28 exports, my role first everywhere, each situation input second and identical wherever taken, one type and @desc per input name, no DEONTIC or EVENT input
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the casino patron: who may ban me and how (s 26), whether the ban is in force (s 26(1b), (3), (4)), review of a casino direction and its $179 fee (s 26A, r 4), the patron's offences with their maximum fines and infringement penalties (ss 23(2)(ii), 26(1d), (6), 27(3), (3a), 27A(4); Schedule 1), forfeiture of winnings (ss 23(2b), 27(3b)), children in the casino (s 27(4)), removal by force (ss 26(1c), (5), 27A), and whether the game is lawful (ss 22(1), 23(1)(b)). Licensing, the Independent Monitor, the casino's own duties, detention (s 32) and unclaimed winnings are out.
lives: jake k080 (2045-09-01): the casino on paydays -- is the game lawful, is it an offence to enter or play
jake k081 (2046-05-08): Chloe looks for a family exclusion order; Jake self-excludes -- may family apply, what can I do, what follows if I go back

roles: I go, or want to go, to a casino in Western Australia
I work at a casino in Western Australia, as a casino employee or key employee
I want to take a child under 18 into a casino with me

situation_parameters.name: I have been banned from the casino
questions: Is the ban on me in force now
May I apply for a review of the ban on me
What fee must I pay for a review of the ban
Does the ban on me stay in force during the review

situation_parameters.name: I have been convicted of a casino offence
questions: Must the court take my winnings

situation_parameters.name: the casino licensee has authorised me to keep people out of the casino
questions: May I prohibit this person from the casino on the spot
How long does my on-the-spot prohibition last at most
May I require this person to state their age
May I remove this person from the casino with reasonable force

situation_parameters.name: I am concerned in organising or managing the casino's gaming operations
questions: Have I committed an offence by letting a person under 18 in
What is the most I can be fined for a person under 18 being let in

situation_parameters.name: I have been convicted under s 23(2) of playing in the casino
questions: Must the court take my winnings from playing where I work

grouped_inputs.why: the site's form gives up its does-not-arise check past 1024 combinations of open yes/no and choice inputs; the baseline's My ban, My visit and Age check together had up to 393216
grouped_inputs.replaces: My ban, My visit, Age check (in the patron's and the employee's questions)
inputs: hours since the ban was made
the casino has been given written notice of the ban
why I am there, and with whom
the game is played to the approved rules
an authorised person suspected I was under 18, my stated age appeared false to them, and I produced no evidence of my age
I had a reasonable excuse for not leaving
